name: boxscore
description: Weekly box score summary for a multifamily property: one row per unit type from the Availability table, plus a few values that apply to the whole document.

property_name.name: Property Name
property_name.description: Property name from the top of the document, below the 'Box Score' heading. Exclude any text in parentheses. Same for every row.

report_date.name: Report Date
report_date.description: The end date of the reporting period from the 'Date = ' line, in YYYY-MM-DD. Same for every row.

code.name: Code
code.description: Unit type code from the 'Code' column of the Availability table, e.g. CR - A1. One per row.

unit_type.name: Unit Type
unit_type.description: Bedroom/bathroom layout from the 'Name' column, e.g. 1x1, 2x2.

units.name: Units
units.description: Total number of units of this type, from the 'Units' column. Whole number.

avg_rent.name: Avg. Rent
avg_rent.description: Average rent of this unit type as a number with no currency symbol.

vacant.name: Vacant
vacant.description: Number of vacant units of this type, from the 'Vacant' column.

percent_leased.name: % Leased
percent_leased.description: Value of the '% Leased' column exactly as printed, e.g. 93.75.
